findings.explanation: HOL4 specifies only `dest_var (Var x ty) = (x,ty)`. Lean returns the same `ARB` pair on every `Const`, `Comb`, and `Abs`. This makes `dest_var (Comb s t) = dest_var (Abs s t)` provable by `rfl` for all `s` and `t`. The HOL4 equation permits those two results to differ.
findings.repair:
private axiom dest_var_other : term → mlstring × type

def dest_var : term → mlstring × type
  | Var x ty => (x, ty)
  | t => dest_var_other t
findings.lean_check:
import CandleLean.HolSyntax

open Candle

example (s t : Candle.term) : dest_var (Comb s t) = dest_var (Abs s t) := rfl
